'''''Cacciucco''''' ({{IPA|it|katˈtʃukko|lang}}) is an [[Italian cuisine|Italian]] [[fish stew]] native to the western coastal towns of [[Tuscany]].<ref name="Meyer">Danny Meyer, ''The Union Square Cafe Cookbook: 160 Favorite Recipes from New York's Acclaimed Restaurant'' (HarperCollins 2005).</ref> It is especially associated with the [[Port|port city]] of [[Livorno]], in Tuscany,<ref name="Chen">Patrizia Chen, ''Rosemary and Bitter Oranges: Growing Up in a Tuscan Kitchen'' (Simon & Schuster, 2010).</ref><ref name="Wright">Clifford A. Wright, ''The Best Stews in the World'', p. 235.</ref> and the town of [[Viareggio]] north of it.<ref name="Wright"/>
